leads.reason: UPDATED this pass: this and G-0416 are the two smaller of a three-oak group at Pettelaarse Schans; the largest, G-0415 (421cm), now ships as dbo_010 with an honest flagged how_to_recognise (the group is genuinely hard to tell apart by eye). This one sits 48m from G-0415, close enough that adding it too would recreate the exact dbo_002 confusion problem this pass exists to fix. Leave for a dedicated future pass with time for aerial imagery or an on-site check, not a rushed second oak.

UPDATED this pass: third and smallest of the Pettelaarse Schans oak trio, 14m from G-0415 (now dbo_010). Same reasoning as G-0421: too close to the shipped oak to add safely without a dedicated distinguishing pass.

UPDATED this pass: the plane among the Pettelaarse Schans oaks, 12m from G-0415 (dbo_010). Not shipped this pass to keep the new Pettelaarse Schans addition to two clean, easily-told-apart trees (dbo_010 oak, dbo_011 poplar); a genuinely good candidate for a future pass, no confusability problem of its own since it is the only plane in the group.

Reverse-geocodes to Hekellaan/Bazeldonk, a residential district distinct from Casinotuin (checked live via Nominatim: 'Bazeldonk' quarter, not 'Binnenstad'), roughly 500-600m from the Casinotuin/Sint Janskerkhof cluster chosen this pass, near what appears to be a sports pitch rather than the historic rampart parkland the rest of the city's trees stand in. Still not shipped this pass for the same reason: joining a dense, walkable core (dbo_005/006/007/008/009, all within ~300m) beats reaching 500m further for a bigger girth alone. Largest girth in the whole 209-candidate pool (531cm, second only to dbo_005's 612cm); worth a dedicated Bazeldonk-area look in a future pass.

blocked.reason: boomenbosch.nl (Boom en Bosch) records a monumental horse chestnut that fell over ('Monumentale kastanje omgevallen') at the corner of Casinotuin and Nachtegaalslaantje. Checked this against dbo_007 (G-0225) and the other Casinotuin chestnut leads above by live register vitality: all read 'Verminderd' (reduced), not dead or removed, so this fallen tree does not appear to be any candidate considered this pass. Recorded here so a future pass does not accidentally verify a chestnut at that corner without checking it is not this known-dead one first.
